item.title: Koufuku no Shokutaku ~Shiawase no Hane~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Honey Soft
  • 発売日: 2007-05-25
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 幸福の食卓～しあわせのはね～
  • 英語名: Koufuku no Shokutaku Shiawase no Hane

别名

  • Table of Happiness

あらすじ

One day, when Hiroki was about to get on a bus, a girl asked directions to him. Due to this, he missed the bus. But he was surprised to hear later that the bus he had missed had a serious traffic accident…. Shortly afterward, his father gets re-married, and a new younger sister, Otoha, starts to live with him, whom he met at the bus stop the other day. One day, he wakes up late, and leaves his house without eating breakfast that Otoha cooked. Since that day, various ominous things happen around him….

item.title: Jun'ai Shoutengai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Honey Soft
  • 発売日: 2005-04-22
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 純愛商店街
  • 英語名: Jun’ai Shoutengai

あらすじ

The protagonist Shingo is an honor student attending an elite academy. While he excels in his studies, his shy and introverted nature makes it difficult for him to create opportunities to meet girls. Currently, he is particularly interested in four girls who live in the nearby shopping district. They are shop attendants from a rice cracker shop, a tea shop, a cake shop, and an esthetic salon. Shingo, unable to initiate a conversation with them, spends his days passing by the shopping district.
